method: Disposable 400k-message archive with 390 stored run days. 100-row live pages and 20k raw Discord backfills through Archive, including derivation, three samples per kind. Writer copied before fixture setup; plugin schedulers disposed. Timer heartbeat conservatively measures uninterrupted segments including commits and scheduling. SQL instrumentation adds overhead. Before setup overlapped the end of focused tests; timed writes followed them. Other machine load was not controlled. No running app or real profile database was accessed.

SELECT COUNT(text) FROM (SELECT ml.link_id AS k, COALESCE(
  (SELECT t.text FROM link_texts t WHERE t.url = l.url AND t.text != '' ORDER BY t.rowid LIMIT 1),
  NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(CASE WHEN (l.title IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT s.channel_id FROM message_links sm JOIN messages s ON s.id = sm.message_id
    WHERE sm.link_id = l.id AND sm.metadata_title = l.title
      AND (s.channel_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM hidden_channels) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids h WHERE instr(s.content, h.id) > 0))) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids h WHERE instr(l.title, h.id) > 0)) AND (s.id = @message))) THEN l.title END, '') || char(10) || COALESCE(CASE WHEN (l.description IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT s.channel_id FROM message_links sm JOIN messages s ON s.id = sm.message_id
    WHERE sm.link_id = l.id AND sm.metadata_description = l.description
      AND (s.channel_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM hidden_channels) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids h WHERE instr(s.content, h.id) > 0))) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids h WHERE instr(l.description, h.id) > 0)) AND (s.id = @message))) THEN l.description END, ''), char(10) || ' '), '')) AS text
                        FROM message_links ml JOIN links l ON l.id = ml.link_id
                        WHERE ml.message_id = @message)

     ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET username = excluded.username, global_name = CASE WHEN @globalNameKnown THEN excluded.global_name ELSE users.global_name END, avatar = CASE WHEN @avatarKnown THEN excluded.avatar ELSE users.avatar END, tag_guild_id = CASE WHEN @tagKnown THEN excluded.tag_guild_id ELSE users.tag_guild_id END, tag = CASE WHEN @tagKnown THEN excluded.tag ELSE users.tag END, tag_badge = CASE WHEN @tagKnown THEN excluded.tag_badge ELSE users.tag_badge END, name_style = CASE WHEN @styleKnown THEN excluded.name_style ELSE users.name_style END, decoration = CASE WHEN @decorationKnown THEN excluded.decoration ELSE users.decoration END, bot = CASE WHEN @botKnown THEN excluded.bot ELSE users.bot END
     WHERE @mergeExisting AND (users.username IS NOT excluded.username OR (@globalNameKnown AND users.global_name IS NOT excluded.global_name) OR (@avatarKnown AND users.avatar IS NOT excluded.avatar) OR (@tagKnown AND users.tag_guild_id IS NOT excluded.tag_guild_id) OR (@tagKnown AND users.tag IS NOT excluded.tag) OR (@tagKnown AND users.tag_badge IS NOT excluded.tag_badge) OR (@styleKnown AND users.name_style IS NOT excluded.name_style) OR (@decorationKnown AND users.decoration IS NOT excluded.decoration) OR (@botKnown AND users.bot IS NOT excluded.bot))

SELECT DISTINCT m.channel_id AS channelId, date(m.ts / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS day
        FROM message_links ml JOIN messages m ON m.id = ml.message_id WHERE ml.link_id = ?

SELECT COUNT(text) FROM (SELECT ml.link_id AS k, COALESCE(
  (SELECT t.text FROM link_texts t WHERE t.url = l.url AND t.text != '' ORDER BY t.rowid LIMIT 1),
  NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(CASE WHEN (l.title IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT s.channel_id FROM message_links sm JOIN messages s ON s.id = sm.message_id
    WHERE sm.link_id = l.id AND sm.metadata_title = l.title
      AND (s.channel_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM hidden_channels) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids h WHERE instr(s.content, h.id) > 0))) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids h WHERE instr(l.title, h.id) > 0)) AND (s.id = @message))) THEN l.title END, '') || char(10) || COALESCE(CASE WHEN (l.description IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT s.channel_id FROM message_links sm JOIN messages s ON s.id = sm.message_id
    WHERE sm.link_id = l.id AND sm.metadata_description = l.description
      AND (s.channel_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM hidden_channels) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids h WHERE instr(s.content, h.id) > 0))) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidden_ids h WHERE instr(l.description, h.id) > 0)) AND (s.id = @message))) THEN l.description END, ''), char(10) || ' '), '')) AS text
                        FROM message_links ml JOIN links l ON l.id = ml.link_id
                        WHERE ml.message_id = @message)
